en: Om, homage to Lokanātha! To Matsyendra, to Viṣṇu, I bow to the Lord of Jinas, the ordainer of the eternal and the non-eternal.
Salutations to you, who are free from conceptual construction and whose splendor is unclad.
O giver of liberation, you who have attained liberation, bestower of the bliss of liberation;
salutations to You, the giver of liberation situated in the center of the Meru-maṇḍala. || 2 ||
Salutations to you, the great-souled Lord of the World, whose noose is the ever-playful God of Love;
salutations to the divine Protector of the World, the Sovereign of the World. || 3 ||
This samādhi is attained by the kinnaras dwelling in the midst of the Golden Mountain for the sake of fame; we worship you, who bestow splendor. (4)
Homage be to you, the Lord, who blazes with the power of mantra, who wears the ornaments of light, the faultless Buddha, the bestower of enlightenment. (5)
O steadfast one who guards the abode and protects those fallen from their station;
salutations again and again to Locanā, Māmakī, Tārā, and Pāṇḍarā. (6)
Salutations be to you, who remove the fear of yakṣas, rākṣasas, vetālas, and serpents; who wear Amitābha as a crown; and who bestow spiritual accomplishments.
Homage to you, the monk with a thousand hairs on his body, for the protection of monks!
O Lord of Samādhi, this eight-verse hymn has been proclaimed as meritorious for you. (8)
The Seven-Syllable Praise of the Glorious Noble Avalokiteśvara is completed.
